fact: On 6 May 2026 ICASEES held a review meeting of the draft statistics law (58 articles), already validated technically in March 2026 and at a national workshop on 23 April 2026, while Law 01.008 of 16 July 2001 remains in force.
title: ICASEES : Réunion de relecture du projet de la loi statistique actualisée
publisher: Institut Centrafricain des Statistiques et des Etudes Economiques et Sociales (ICASEES)
